photo1.jpg.title: First trip together🫶🫶
photo1.jpg.caption: Our first time travelling together from office. I had no idea how much that little moment would change my life. Thank God I asked you and you said yes without a second thought ❤️

photo2.jpg.title: Our first Date💓
photo2.jpg.caption: I'll never forget how beautiful you looked in that white top with two roses in your hand while I showed up in my gym clothes🫣 You picked the perfect rooftop for our first date, then came our first sushi and our first kiss. I'm still so glad it was you.

photo3.jpg.title: Our Mumbai Metro adventure💘
photo3.jpg.caption: We decided on a whim to travel by Mumbai Metro and somehow it became one of my favourite days. Beaches and my favourite person — what more could I ask for ❤️

photo4.jpg.title: The saree moment😘😘
photo4.jpg.caption: I only asked for a photo and you went all out with a saree and jewellery. You made me feel so special that day. I still don't have the words for how gorgeous you looked ❤️

photo5.jpg.title: The Dombivli plan😁
photo5.jpg.caption: Even after the movie and your Vitamin B moment iykyk🌚 we still made our way to Dombivli because I wanted to visit that restaurant with you. And that little kiss outside before leaving made it even better🫂

photo6.jpg.title: One of my favourite days💘💘
photo6.jpg.caption: The start wasn't perfect and you weren't feeling your best, but it turned into one of the best days I've spent with you. I just wish time had stopped when I was with you, enjoying you putting chocolate on me and I got to see a different version of Chrisine🌚💘

photo7.jpg.title: Picking up right where we left off💓💓
photo7.jpg.caption: After some difficult conversations, this was the first time we met again and everything still felt the same. Also you brought a sunflower which is my favourite flower which you remembered then we went on that ride which still scares me to this day😂 But with you, I'd happily do it again.
